description.value: Chilango Modern Mexican is a contemporary sit-down restaurant on Kelowna's main downtown corridor, Bernard Avenue, specializing in Mexican street-food-inspired dishes including tacos, burritos, and craft cocktails spanning brunch through late-night service. It is the sister restaurant to El Taquero, a Kelowna institution next door that has been serving traditional street tacos for over 10 years. Positive guest reviews highlight the food quality, friendly service, and lively atmosphere, making it a viable meal stop for cyclists rolling through downtown Kelowna.
